Browse the reports, apps, and APIs published on Posit Connect.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(connectapi)
source("content_hub.R")

# connect() reads CONNECT_SERVER and CONNECT_API_KEY, which Connect sets
# whenever it renders this document. The key carries the permissions of the
# hub's owner, so the hub lists what the owner can see, not what each viewer
# can see; the README covers who to share it with.
client <- connect()
items <- hub_items(get_content(client))
featured <- featured_items(items, parse_tags(Sys.getenv("FEATURED_TAGS")))
```

The list below was last updated `r format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y at %H:%M %Z")`.

## `r featured$heading`

```{r}
card_grid(featured$items)
```

## All content

```{r}
# The page is static, so filtering happens in the browser: reactable's search
# box and per-column filters work on the data embedded in the page.
content_table(items, searchable = TRUE)
```
